title: WARNING about Lotus Garden Nails on Bellaire - got an infection
where: SW Houston Neighbors board > Local Businesses

messages.author: ReneeK_Meyerland
messages.body: Posting this so nobody else goes through what I did. Got a deluxe pedicure at Lotus Garden Nails on Bellaire on Oct 24. The tech went way too deep on my big toe cuticle and it bled. A week later the toe was red, swollen and hot. Ended up at urgent care on antibiotics. I went back to the salon to tell them and the owner basically shrugged at me. I'm not one to leave bad reviews but this is a health issue. Please be careful where you go, ladies.

messages.author: dave_in_gulfton
messages.body: Not surprised honestly. Half these strip mall nail places reuse the same files on everybody and the tubs are nasty. My wife quit going years ago. Hope your toe gets better.

messages.author: MarisolB
messages.body: So sorry Renee, that sounds painful. Just curious, did they offer you anything when you went back? I've been going to Lotus Garden for maybe 4 years and never had a problem, they always open the tools from a sealed bag in front of me. Not saying you're lying, just surprised. Maybe it's worth talking to the owner again?

messages.author: ReneeK_Meyerland
messages.body: @MarisolB they offered me my $45 back like that covers urgent care and a week of not being able to wear shoes. The girl who did it barely spoke English so I couldn't even explain to her what I wanted. I asked for something reasonable and the owner said no. Glad it's been fine for you but I'm telling my experience. Already filed with the state too.
